name: The Kobeissi Letter
zh_summary: @KobeissiLetter: the FY2026 US deficit widened 12% to $1.99 trillion from $1.78 trillion; spending rose 6% to $7.4 trillion and net interest topped $1 trillion, the third largest expense after Social Security and Medicare.
en_summary: @KobeissiLetter: the FY2026 US deficit widened 12% to $1.99 trillion from $1.78 trillion; spending rose 6% to $7.4 trillion and net interest topped $1 trillion, the third largest expense after Social Security and Medicare.
text:
BREAKING: The US deficit widened to $1.99 trillion for FY2026, up +12% from the $1.78 trillion recorded last year.

Spending rose by +6%, to $7.4 trillion, and NET interest officially rose above $1 trillion.

Debt servicing costs are now their third largest expense for the US government, only behind Social Security and Medicare.

This marks the fourth-straight year with the US fiscal deficit around $2 trillion.

The deficit spending crisis is out of control.

name: Luke Gromen
zh_summary: @LukeGromen: US interest plus entitlements is 105% of receipts in a good economy and growing 2.5x faster; doing nothing, cutting entitlements or cutting defense all lead to USD up and rates up until the system crashes or the Fed prints.
en_summary: @LukeGromen: US interest plus entitlements is 105% of receipts in a good economy and growing 2.5x faster; doing nothing, cutting entitlements or cutting defense all lead to USD up and rates up until the system crashes or the Fed prints.
text:
because you're not identifying the problems, IMO.

US Interest + Entitlements is 105% of receipts in a good economy, growing 2.5x receipts.  Do nothing, you're going to get USD up, rates up, until system crashes or you print.

Cut Entitlements, you get USD up, receipts down, deficit up, rates up, until the system crashes or you print.

Cut defense, you get USD up, rates up, deficit up, until the system crashes or you print.

The only option they have is cut rates toward 0% and shift issuance forward.  My gold proposal is one way of doing that.

That's the only way out now.

Details: 200L carbon-over wrapped pressure vessel behind seat holds nitrogen at 10,000 PSI; cold gas thrusters push out 80 kN of thrust (equivalent to a single fighter jet engine); Tesla went with nitrogen because “it just seemed wrong to put fuel into a car” (air is ~80% nitrogen); thrusters same system as satellites.

Demographics, debt, debasement. Three words that drive everything.

It starts with an aging population. Fewer workers means slower growth, so governments borrow to keep the economy moving. The debt keeps growing because the demographics leave them no other option.

That debt was never going to be paid back. So it gets managed instead... by debasing the currency. More money created every year, each unit worth a little less than the last. Slowly enough that most people never notice.

That is The Everything Code. Debasement sets the real hurdle rate for your money, and over the long run only two assets have cleared it... crypto and technology. 

But thats only the first part of the story. The Exponential Age is where everything goes vertical at once. And the end state is The Economic Singularity, where everything changes.
